QuestInfo.0: Mouri Motonari has requested your presence! What could he need?
QuestInfo.1: Mouri Motonari has requested your presence! What could he need?
QuestInfo.2: You have received a new weapon and armor from Mouri Motonari.

0.0: You've grown very strong in this new world, Hayato. I am pleased to see my faith in you was well-placed.
0.1: Your equipment is ready. The blacksmiths have been working around the clock. I hope you will treasure them, as we treasure your service.
